runtime: Real Python in Pyodide Web Workers; no computation backend

modules.implementation: NumPy port of all previously shipped website computations; independent browser numerical adaptation, not complete upstream Wolfram API compatibility
coverage: projective irreducible representations
Wigner a/b/c corepresentations
full k-star induction
arbitrary k-star tensor decomposition
vasp2trace/MagVasp2trace parsing and character matching
limitations: no automatic general POSCAR/CIF to BC conversion

modules.implementation: Independent NumPy implementation of numerical symmetry-constrained tight-binding, band and topology workflows; not API-complete upstream Rust/Python replacement.
Exact base crystallographic algorithms. See crystkit_extensions.py and carat_browser.py for added cohomology, normalizer proof cases, infinite generation and high-dimensional Q catalogue.
implemented: Exact rational affine multiplication, inversion, basis/origin changes and quotient closure
Finite quotient minimum generators, solvability, derived series, point orbits and stabilizers
Invariant Gram form and exact symmorphic origin congruences (73 of 230 3D space groups)
Arbitrary rational affine-generator simplification via Schreier translations, Hermite lattice basis, orientation-preserving Gram LLL and origin rationalization
Certified 3D database identification with exact origin shifts and optional orientation-preserving signed-permutation bases
Verified affine equivalence under supplied or signed-permutation lattice bases
SNoT orbits modulo origin shifts under supplied point-group normalizer generators
Rational finite-matrix-group conjugacy with verified certificates and explicit inconclusive search status
Prime-power inverse Euler totient and new/cumulative finite element orders of GL(n,Z)
Contiguous direct-sum matrix blocks and affine coordinate expressions
not_implemented: General unbounded GL(n,Z) normalizer and Q-to-Z classification

limits.generator_indices: zero based; minimum generators refer to the finite quotient
limits.identification: Positive matches are certified; no_match_in_search is not a nonisomorphism proof
limits.matrix_conjugacy: Bounded image assignments and invertible-intertwiner search report inconclusive when necessary

modules.validation: 13 scientific regression tests; all 230 database closures and invariant Gram forms; independent cyclotomic orders through 12D; literal upstream nonstandard SG227 generators; exact affine and conjugacy certificates; negative and malformed inputs

modules.implementation: Independent exact Python classification with the complete official 1–6D Q catalogue
coverage: 8329 exact Q representatives with presentations and source hashes
Exact finite integral matrix groups, characteristic invariants and rational central idempotents
Certified rational conjugators and explicit integral-unimodular positive certificates
All invariant column-HNF sublattices within a requested finite index
Selected integral representative links to exact cohomology and affine orbits
limitations: General Q-to-Z and all high-dimensional Z representatives not implemented
Official affine/Z counts are metadata, not generated representative lists
Bounded conjugator search can be inconclusive
Browser time and memory bounds apply

modules.implementation: Exact integer Cayley relation lattices and Smith transformations
coverage: Complete H1(P,Q^d/Z^d) for a fixed integral point group, modulo every origin shift
Certified full normalizers for scalar groups, integral diagonal sign blocks, and unique invariant quadratic forms
Normalizer extension orbits with explicit completeness and orientation split
Infinite space-group generation via Schreier translation lattice certificate
Abelianization lower bound and certified upper bound; minimum only when bounds coincide
Exact origin-congruence affine comparison for supplied bases
limitations: Other normalizers are finite metric subgroups, explicitly incomplete
Different integral representations in one Q class are not automatically enumerated
Candidate generator searches may establish bounds only

modules.implementation: Independent exact SymPy constraints, rational-function and algebraic domains; no float-to-symbolic reconstruction
coverage: Restricted AST mathematical expression parsing
Exact expression/matrix algebra, rank conditions and cyclotomic fields
Exact Hermitian and unitary/antiunitary hopping constraints
Closed polynomial orbital bases including f orbitals
Symbolic Bloch and finite-degree k.p Hamiltonians, small exact spectra
Explicit parameter substitution bridge to numerical bands
limitations: Not a complete upstream API compatibility layer
General parameter ranks require conditions and exceptional-value recomputation
Symbolic geometry requires explicit closed bonds
No spin-space-group catalogue, DFT fitting or general symbolic SG/MSG representation standardization

coordinate_conventions.MagneticTB: Row lattice vectors; fractional direct positions and reciprocal k; rotations act on columns; periodic orbital gauge H_ij(k)=sum_R t_ij(R) exp(2πi k·R).
coordinate_conventions.CrystKit: Rational column coordinates; x_old=B*x_new+origin for basis changes.

notes: CrystKit original sources remain GPL-2.0-or-later; GPL-3 compatibility uses the original later-version permission.
Existing SpaceGroupIrep and MSGCorep provenance remains in dist/data/provenance.json.

pythonRuntime.execution: module Web Worker, single task at a time, no input transfer to backend
